title: Items that are running out
prompt: Return an array of the names whose amount is below 2, in order.
hints: Loop over keys, test the value, append the key.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: data[key]
docs.what: The value stored under key. Assigning to it changes or adds the entry.
